description:
**Organization:**

To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Chief Engineer

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

The Technology group delivers the groups information technology functions to ensure the highest levels of customer service through excellent process excellence and technology innovation. We deliver available, reliable, consistent technology solutions for our internal and external customers, essential tools for our people and innovative product platforms for our customers (including Netbank and CommSec). We are driven to balance three key dynamics to ensure our success: being safe, sound and secure, ensuring agility and driving performance. We put the customer at the centre of everything we do and measure our performance against the groups’ external customer satisfaction measures.

The Corporate Technology team is the engine room of the CBA group dedicated to running, improving and transforming the processes that deliver products, services and productivity benefits to the CBA group customers. The CBA India Corporate Technology organization has footprint across Financial Crimes Technology, KYC, Digitization Technology, Workflow Centre of Excellence, Integrations, RPA, Operations Enablement and Corporate Services Technology team is composed of engineers and technology leaders, who bring in the right mix of skills to enable this transformation. We also work very closely with our business and operations colleagues to support these services which are critical to the Australian and Global economy. The scope for Corporate Technology being Operations, Financial Crime, Finance, Risk, HR, Legal.

Group Operations are the transaction champions of Enterprise Services — working to ensure the production, validation and fulfilment of all consumer and commercial financial transactions and trades on behalf of the Group.

Enterprise Services (ES) is responsible for the world leading application of technology and operations across every aspect of CommBank, from innovative product platforms for our customers to essential tools within our business. We also use technology to drive efficient and timely processing, an essential component of great customer service.

  

**Reporting Lines:**

* Direct line reporting into the General Manager, Corporate Technology, India
Functional (dotted line) reporting into the General Manager, Corporate Technology, Engineering  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Chief Engineer plays a pivotal role to deliver on Payments Technology purpose through quality execution and delivery.
* Leverage metrics and data to inform continuous improvement opportunities that increase the effectiveness of the Chapter.
* Implement, evolve and support consistent ways of working across the Chapter and CBA business that align to industry standards.
* Uplift Chapters maturity by fostering a culture of sharing, learning and problem solving across Chapter Areas.
* Facilitate the constructive resolution of conflicts which may arise both internally & externally to the Chapter.
* Participate and contribute to the Practice and/or Chapter including maintaining technical experience commensurate with their specific Chapter.
* Providing oversight and leadership of data projects with strategic business and customer value optimizing the resource model for efficiency and scale with resources located onshore and offshore.
* Building world-class team culture and engagement with a strong focus on career development.
Adhere to the Code of Conduct. The Code of Conduct sets the standards of behaviour, actions and decisions we expect from our people

An experienced senior leader who has demonstrated success achieving measurable performance improvements across large and complex businesses.

* 15+ years’ experience preferably gained in Banking and Finance.
* Have hands-on experience working with the Ability to drive and influence senior level stakeholder engagement across business and technology.
* Leadership experience across multi-disciplinary teams
* Excellent communication skills, especially in relation to verbal communications and proven presentation skills to large audience.
* Experienced technologist that understands data platforms and their capabilities

**Technical Skills**

* **Cloud** : AWS, Serverless, Containers, and VM Hosting
* **Databases** : AWS Database technologies (Aurora, RDS, Redis)
* **Languages** : Typescript **,** Java **,** Python, C#
* **Eventing** : SQS, SNS, EventBridge, KAFKA (MKS)
* **Engineering** : Github, Github Actions, Terraform Enterprise, Artifactory, AKKA, SST
* **Observability** : OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Observe, CloudWatch

**Design skills**

* **Testing:** TDD, BDD, Automation Framework
* **System Design:** Tech debt, data-intensive applications, database design, API design, microservices, event-driven and serverless architecture
* **Engineering:** Deployment methodologies, SRE

* **AI:** AI in engineering (e.g., Cline, CoPilot), RAG, MCP, Gen-AI, Agentic-AI, machine learning

**Job Overview**

The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. This role supports key business functions, including finance, order management, inventory, procurement, shipping, and engineering.

You will collaborate with global SAP, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams to maintain a stable SAP landscape, drive continuous improvement, identify automation opportunities, and support strategic technology initiatives. **What You Will Do**

* **SAP Landscape Management:** Execute SAP infrastructure and architecture roadmaps, ensuring system stability, availability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* **System Administration:** Install, configure, patch, maintain, and refresh SAP applications and database systems.
* **Performance Optimization:** Monitor system performance, analyze resource utilization, perform tuning and capacity management, and proactively identify potential issues.
* **Incident and Service Management:** Handle service management tickets, troubleshoot system issues, perform health checks, and support break/fix activities.
* **Infrastructure Collaboration:** Partner with data center, network, storage, security, and database teams to deliver reliable and secure SAP solutions.
* **High Availability and Disaster Recovery:** Support SAP infrastructure design and initiatives involving high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* **Automation and Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to automate routine activities, improve operational efficiency, and enhance existing processes.
* **Documentation:** Develop and maintain technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, design documents, requirements, and test scripts.
* **Business-Critical Support:** Support SAP Digital Technology (DT) teams during critical system outages, planned maintenance, and operational activities.
* **Global Support:** Participate in on-call rotations, work in US hours as required, and provide weekend support when necessary.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to a large, global SAP landscape supporting critical enterprise business functions.
* Develop deeper expertise in SAP infrastructure architecture, system performance, and landscape management.
* Understand high-availability solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
* Explore automation opportunities and continuous improvement initiatives across SAP operations.
* Collaborate with global technical teams and business stakeholders on strategic SAP initiatives.
* Contribute to SAP modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

* 6+ years of experience working in an SAP Basis administration role.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, databases, and application architecture.
* Hands-on experience administering SAP ECC, BW, PI, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA systems.
* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organizational levels, including leadership.
* Ability to work in a global support environment, including US working hours, on-call rotations, and occasional weekend support.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience working in a large, complex, global SAP environment.
* Knowledge of SAP technologies, architecture, interfaces, and batch processing.
* Experience with Oracle databases, SAP HANA, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and/or Lean methodologies.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, CRM, SNC, SLT, Hybris, and SAP Web Dispatcher.
* Knowledge of web technologies, firewalls, proxy servers, and Single Sign-On (SSO) frameworks.
* Experience supporting SAP system upgrades, migrations, integrations, and infrastructure improvements.

* Drive the adoption of data-driven decision-making across IT operations by promoting effective use of metrics and performance insights.

* Identify opportunities for reporting automation and process optimization to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

* Experience supporting global IT operations and service delivery organizations.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical metrics to business outcomes.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in service performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency through analytics and reporting.

Enable now SAP application, Product Champion.

* 3+ years of experience developing and managing enterprise-level KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting.
